subject.title: Add a Sealos Devbox SSH-lease provider

question: Should Crabbox accept a built-in Sealos Devbox SSH-lease provider now, and what proof or waiver is required for the CRD, Secret, SSH routing, and retained-release contract?
rationale: This adds a new remote provider and credential-handling surface, and the repository vision requires real create/use/destroy proof unless maintainers explicitly accept the environment-blocked risk.

options.title: Require live proof and contract approval
options.body: Keep the issue open until the linked provider branch or replacement has redacted live Sealos proof plus maintainer approval of the CRD, Secret, SSHGate/NodePort, and retained-release behavior.

options.title: Accept a maintainer-owned proof waiver
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly waive live proof and own first real-cluster validation after merge if the product need outweighs the risk.

options.title: Pause the built-in provider direction
options.body: Keep the request open but do not merge an implementation until the supported Sealos automation and routing contracts are confirmed.

recommendation.title: Require live proof and contract approval
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until the linked provider branch or replacement has redacted live Sealos proof plus maintainer approval of the CRD, Secret, SSHGate/NodePort, and retained-release behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider lifecycle and security-hardening history makes this the best available routing candidate for the proof and contract decision.
